description.en:
Change everything on ALL land, also land you do not own.
- Landscaping: raise, lower, smooth, flatten and slope terrain - Paint terrain textures and foliage (grass, bushes, ...) - Plant trees and cut trees with the chainsaw - Place buildings, fences and other placeables
Still respected: money, farm permissions, restricted zones and the shop/vehicle spawn areas. Works in singleplayer and multiplayer (the mod must be active on the server).
